stem: The graph of f(x) = x^2 is reflected over the x-axis and is stretched horizontally to create the graph of function g. Which graph could represent g?
visual_elements: Graph labeled F: upward parabola, vertex at origin
Graph labeled H: narrow upward parabola, vertex at origin
Graph labeled G: narrow downward parabola, vertex at origin
Graph labeled J: wide downward parabola, vertex at origin
